dimensions.assessment: Affects federal water management agencies, regional water users, and participating watersheds utilizing snowpack forecasting.
Updates program focus and reporting criteria without altering fundamental legal rights or imposing major new restrictions.
Authorizes $3,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031.
dimensions.evidence: and inserting ``$3,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031''

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Snow Water Supply Forecasting Program Authorization Act to incorporate emerging technologies like machine learning and imaging spectroscopy.
Extends program authorization and funding across a five-year period from fiscal year 2027 through 2031.
